lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.focus: a scaled bar graph from a data set
lessonRef.title: Independent evidence A: a scaled bar graph from a data set

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One reference example. Use it only if you get stuck.

items.prompt: A scaled bar graph uses a scale of 5 per symbol. A bar shows 3 symbols. What does that bar represent?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 5 per symbol, "Dogs" has 7 symbols and "Cats" has 1 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Oranges" is worth 6 symbols. How many does "Oranges" represent?
On a scaled bar graph with 2 per symbol, "Dogs" has 4 symbols and "Cats" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Dogs" is worth 1 symbols. How many does "Dogs" represent?
On a scaled bar graph with 5 per symbol, "Red" has 3 symbols and "Blue" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Red" have than "Blue"?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 10 per symbol. The bar for "Grapes" is worth 6 symbols. How many does "Grapes" represent?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 2 per symbol, "Dogs" has 7 symbols and "Cats" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
